text: あまり　ロケットだんの　じゃまを　しない　ほうが　みの　ため　だぜ！

structure.jp: あまり　ロケットだんの　じゃまを　しない　ほうが
structure.en: not getting in Team Rocket's way too much

structure.jp: みの　ため　だぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ないほうがいい
patterns.explanation: A 'not' verb plus ほうが says that not doing it is the better choice; here the usual いい is replaced by みのためだ. しない　ほうが = 'it's better not to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜のため
patterns.explanation: のため after a thing means 'for the good of' it. みの　ため = 'for your own good'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. だぜ = 'it is, I tell you'.
